name: Research specific food and beverage product details
description: Users asked for detailed factual information about the composition, production processes, origins, and properties of specific food items and beverages, such as tea, coffee, beer, dairy, and sweets. The requests focused on identifying ingredients, clarifying product definitions, and understanding preparation methods or cultural associations of these consumables.
